tasks.title: CLP/JPY/KWD amounts rendered with the wrong number of decimals
tasks.summary: Fixed Amount.Decimal() which always divided by 100 and printed two decimals. It now uses the currency Factor/Exponent so CLP/JPY render with 0 decimals, KWD with 3, and USD/EUR/etc. unchanged at 2. Added regression tests for those currencies.

tasks.title: Multiple partial refunds can exceed the captured amount
tasks.summary: Fixed PAY-4420: Refund compared the request to the full payment amount instead of Remaining(), so stacked partial refunds could overshoot. It now rejects amounts above remaining with ErrRefundExceedsRemaining (HTTP 422) and leaves the payment unchanged; refunding exactly the remainder still moves status to REFUNDED. Added a regression test for the m_8812 scenario.

tasks.title: Cursor pagination silently drops one payment per page
tasks.summary: Fixed ListByMerchant cursor paging: next_cursor already encoded the exclusive end (next start index), but decode applied an extra offset++, skipping one payment per page. Removed the double-advance and added a walk-all-pages regression test (including exact multiples of limit).

tasks.title: Webhook dispatcher retries permanent 4xx failures and gives up on 5xx
tasks.summary: Fixed inverted webhook retryable() logic: 5xx/408/429 and transport errors are retried with backoff; other 4xx (400/401/404/410) go straight to dead-letter with Attempts and LastStatus recorded. Added regression tests for both merchant scenarios.

tasks.title: Idempotency keys never expire after 24h
tasks.summary: Fixed idempotency TTL handling in Memory store: Begin now treats keys as unused once now >= ExpiresAt (allowing new payments after 24h), and purgeLocked evicts on that same boundary instead of ExpiresAt+TTL (which kept records ~48h and caused the replay/memory-growth bugs). Added expiry and purge tests.

tasks.title: Every client error is returned as 500 internal_error
tasks.summary: Fixed errorResponse in api/errors.go to map domain errors with errors.Is instead of switch equality, so wrapped errors (fmt.Errorf with %w) still yield 404/409/422/400 and the documented codes instead of 500 internal_error.

tasks.title: Late webhook retries fire with no delay
tasks.summary: Fixed Policy.Backoff overflow: BaseDelay<<(n-1) wrapped int64 for large n (enterprise MaxAttempts: 48), collapsing delays to ≤0 and causing retry storms. Backoff now doubles with overflow/MaxDelay guards so waits stay positive, non-decreasing, and capped. Added enterprise regression test.

tasks.title: Add payment cancellation (CANCELED status + endpoint + webhook)
tasks.summary: Implemented payment cancel (PAY-4502): StatusCanceled (final, ParseStatus), Service.Cancel from CREATED/PENDING with payment.canceled event, and POST /payments/{id}/cancel (200/409/404). Canceled payments reject authorize/capture/decline/refund.

tasks.title: Filter the merchant payment listing by status
tasks.summary: Implemented optional `status` query filtering on GET /merchants/{merchantID}/payments. ParseStatus validates the param (400 invalid_request on unknown). payment.Page carries Status through to Memory.ListByMerchant, which filters in creation order and paginates so full pages stay full and each match is returned once. Unfiltered listing is unchanged.

tasks.title: Replay a dead-lettered webhook event
tasks.summary: Implemented Dispatcher.Replay (remove dead-letter, re-deliver same event id/payload with normal retries, ErrDeadLetterNotFound) and POST /webhooks/dead-letters/{eventID}/replay (200 with delivered flag, 404 not_found).

tasks.title: Accept and return integer minor units, backward compatible
tasks.summary: Added backward-compatible integer minor-unit amounts on create/refund: resolveAmount accepts amount and/or amount_minor (exactly one required; both must agree). Payment/refund responses now include amount_minor, fee_minor, refunded_minor, remaining_minor, and refunds[].amount_minor. Idempotency fingerprints already use minor units, so cross-format retries replay correctly.

tasks.title: Centralize the payment status machine in one transition table
tasks.summary: Added payment.CanTransition as the single source of truth for allowed status changes (CREATED→PENDING/DECLINED, PENDING→SUCCEEDED/DECLINED, SUCCEEDED→REFUNDED). Refactored Authorize, Capture, Decline, and Refund to validate via CanTransition only—no status switches remain in service.go. Partial refunds still stay SUCCEEDED and are gated by the same SUCCEEDED→REFUNDED check; public behaviour and errors unchanged.

tasks.title: Idempotency store is not safe under concurrent retries
tasks.summary: Fixed concurrent map races and duplicate Begin in idempotency.Memory by holding mu for the full critical sections in Begin, Complete, and Release (Begin no longer unlocks between lookup and insert). Added concurrent tests; go test -race ./... passes.

tasks.title: In-memory repository shares mutable state with callers
tasks.summary: Fixed DATA RACE and phantom refunds by deep-cloning Payment (via Clone) on Memory Create/Get/Update/ListByMerchant so repository values never share Refunds with storage. A failed optimistic update can no longer leave stray refunds; added TestRefundsIsolation regression coverage.

tasks.title: Idempotency Begin gets slower with every stored key
tasks.summary:
Fixed PAY-4570: idempotency.Memory.Begin was O(n log n) because it sorted and scanned every record on each call.

- Treat expired keys as absent on lookup (delete + fresh begin) so they are never replayed.
- Run full eviction at most once per minute with a linear map scan (no sort).
- Begin stays O(1) for the common path while memory stays bounded.

tasks.title: Split payouts do not reconcile with the charged amount
tasks.summary: Fixed money.Allocate to use integer largest-remainder distribution instead of float64/Round. Parts now always sum to the input: floor shares first, then give leftover minor units one-by-one to the largest fractional remainders (lower index wins ties), matching the documented contract and the 100.00/3, 0.10/7, and 0.05/2 reconciliation cases.

tasks.title: Identical retries rejected as idempotency key reuse
tasks.summary: Fixed idempotency fingerprinting so mobile SDK retries replay instead of 422. bodyFingerprint now canonicalizes JSON (stable key order) and normalizes amount decimals ("10.50"/"10.5") and currency case ("USD"/"usd"). Added regression tests for payment create and refund rebuilt-JSON retries.

tasks.title: Processing fees overcharged by one cent
tasks.summary: Fixed money.Fee to follow finance half-to-even (banker's) rounding with exact integer math via math/big instead of math.Ceil/float64. A 10.05 USD charge at 290 bps now fees 0.29, and large minor-unit amounts no longer drift from float precision loss.
